$comment: The Ongoing Certification Report and Quarterly Review calendar (CCM-OCR-SOR, CCM-QTR-SAR, CCM-OCR-NRD, CCM-QTR-NRD). Read by scripts/_ocr_calendar.py. A report is due on each issue date; the Quarterly Review follows the report's release by review_business_days business days (Monday to Friday; federal holidays are not counted out).

issue_dates.why: The 15th of the middle month of each quarter, spread away from the quarter's start and end (CCM-OCR-SOR).

first_period_start_why: The day this system adopted CR26 and retired its POA&M (2026-11-04); the first report covers from then.
